name: Aamir Bonamis
story: Aamir Bonamis worked on New Zealand Police’s ArcGIS Enterprise implementation in 2021 and co-presented the Police Geospatial Team’s FME case study in 2023. The presentation covered automated Calls for Service workflows, combining call data with crime-harm and location information, dashboards, and hourly updates during Cyclone Gabrielle.
